g.text: Detailed Web, API, Selection and Export Integration
A - Application shell and dataset loading

text.tspan: The canonical provenance catalogue exposes the coordinate-register files as downloads; the frontend still relies on explicit availability contracts rather than filenames.
The audit files document existing evidence and QC. They do not independently authorize a scientific view or alter linked selection semantics.
Home - Overview - Gene Explorer - Boundary - Gallery - My Runs
